title: Contribution déterminée au niveau national de Djibouti (CDN de Djibouti), version révisée
organization: Republic of Djibouti, Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development; UNFCCC repository
temporal_coverage: Revised NDC implementation period 2024–2030; climate projections to 2050 and longer-term risks.
methodology: Revised government NDC reports climate-risk analysis and adaptation commitments.
limitations: French-language policy estimates; some scenarios are unspecified.

title: Djibouti Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: CCDR summary presents projections to 2050 and mid-century.
methodology: World Bank Group CCDR country page with substantive report summary, risk estimates, and priority recommendations.
limitations: The linked full report was not inspected; claims are confined to the opened CCDR summary page.

title: Djibouti: Climate Action Can Protect Growth and Build Resilience
temporal_coverage: CCDR press release summarizes long-term climate risk through 2050 and current coastal-city exposure.
methodology: World Bank Group press release summarizing the first Djibouti CCDR and its priority risks.
limitations: Press-release summary, not the full CCDR; model assumptions are not included in the release.
